last_attempts_log.asr_text: The team used pictures from the moon probe LRO. They looked for cliffs on the moon's surface and marked them on a map. A wrinkle is a cliff with one steep side and one less steep side. Scientists think these cliffs show where solid rock was squeezed together. One side was pushed up over the other. The cliffs are a record of a huge shoving match cut into the moon's surface.
